verdict.rationale: LegalZoom ships a few vendor-defined features that run in the background without user action: automatic mileage capture, real-time compliance status notifications, mail-arrival alerts, and Compliance Calendar email reminders for annual report deadlines. However, nothing shows a user can create or configure their own automations or agentic workflows. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation or workflow builder, AI agents acting autonomously on the user's behalf, triggers/actions or API/integration hooks, and documentation or hands-on corroboration of any autonomous automation capability.
